## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T09:01Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p2:** `record:path` ticks every stage before the current one by position, so a stage the record skipped reads as passed. That is a misleading status on an audit-facing page. First measure whether the record's state history is already readable on the page: if it is, tick only the visited stages. If a stage needs a new declared key on `RecordPathProps` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:2187`), that is a protocol addition, p1, `domain:spec`, and it comes back to triage before it is built.

## 待维护者裁决 · record:path 如何不再把「跳过的阶段」画成「已通过」

席位 `domain:ui#4` · `session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T` · 2026-10-27T11:50Z · 依据 os-dev 报告 6441110297(停止条件命中,未改代码、未开 PR)

**一句话问题:** 一份订单合同按设计不走法务审查,但合同页上方的阶段条依然显示「审查中 ✓」,审计人员会读成"法务审过了"。

**背景(实测,origin/main `498e8f40`):** 阶段条 `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`(:443 桌面、:514 移动)按位置给当前阶段之前的每一格打勾。它唯一能读到的是当前记录行(`RecordContextValue`,`ui/packages/react/src/context/RecordContext.tsx:113`),读不到状态历史。页面上的两条历史读取(`sys_audit_log` 需 `trackHistory` 开启、只在历史页签可见时读、最多 50 条;`sys_activity` 只在动态块可见时读)都到不了阶段条。而且这两条历史天生不完整(可关闭、对读者隐藏的字段行被扣留、有条数上限),所以"历史里没有"也证明不了"跳过了"。

**Governing text:** `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`(选项 `visibleWhen`):"option is offered only when TRUE (else omitted) … the rule validator refuses a write of a value whose predicate is false … so a user-gated CHOICE belongs here"。`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:186-188`:"That gate is the server's enforcement of who may pick an option (ADR-0124 D1)"。分诊评论 6437783999:新的阶段键属协议新增,p1、`domain:spec`,须回分诊。

**协议声明:** 选项 A 不改协议;C 改协议(新增键)。

**带 re-check 命令的前提:**
- 阶段条按位置打勾:`git grep -n "idx < currentIdx\|index < currentIndex" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`(对照词:`git grep -c "statusField" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx` 必中)。
- 选项 `visibleWhen` 由服务端强制:`git grep -n "who may pick an option" origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户看到的后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | 阶段条复用状态字段选项上已有的 `visibleWhen`:对本记录为假的选项不画成阶段;谓词出错则照画;谓词引用 `current_user` 的不据以隐藏(那是"谁能选",不是"记录走哪条路") | 应用声明"订单类合同不可选审查中"后,订单合同的阶段条不再出现审查中 | ui 车道 · 1 个 PR(record-path.tsx + 测试 + changeset)· 无先例 |
| **B** | 阶段条自己去读 `sys_activity`/`sys_audit_log`,只给历史里出现过的值打勾 | 每个带阶段条的记录页多一次请求;历史缺失时只能猜,或新增"未知"态(又一个产品决定) | ui 车道 · 1 个 PR + 一次新读取 · 无先例 |
| **C** | `RecordPathProps.stages[]` 新增每阶段条件键 | 作者可单独声明阶段显隐,不依赖选项 | spec 车道 + ui 消费端 · 2 个 PR · 需契约复审档复核 |

**业务含义直译:** A = "不能选的路就不画";B = "去翻流水账,翻不到就猜";C = "给阶段条单独开一个开关"。

**四轴(业务立场):**
- 项目长远合理性:A 复用一个已声明且服务端强制的契约,不新增面;类比主流平台按"记录类型 → 可用选项"决定路径阶段。B 让渲染器依赖不完整的数据源。C 增加一个与选项可见性重叠的第二处声明。
- 实际业务拉动:今天撞上的是 hotclm 订单合同(按合同类型跳过法务),正是"按本记录字段决定可选值"的规则,A 正好能表达;C 无 A 之外的实测拉动。
- 防 AI 犯错:A 由声明驱动、写入时服务端拒绝,出错是响亮的;B 静默猜测;C 让 AI 要在两处声明同一件事,容易不一致。
- 创业阶段不扩散:A 零新键、零新读取、零新门禁;C 新增永久义务。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 缩小特例(复用既有选项契约),C 扩大契约增生。
- ② 实际业务拉动:hotclm 订单合同今天撞上;A 覆盖该场景,C 零额外拉动。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 声明驱动且写入强制、响亮;B 静默猜测;C 双处声明易漂移。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A remove/复用优于 C 的 declare-and-maintain。
Prior rulings read: option visibleWhen, record path stage → ADR-0124 D1 (who may pick an option), ADR-0137 D2/D3 (render side fail-open); thread: 6437783999

**推荐:A。** 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。置信缺口:A 把"谁能选这个值"读成"这条记录走不走这一步",谓词引用 `current_user` 时两者不同,所以 A 带了"引用 `current_user` 的谓词不据以隐藏"这条护栏;这个护栏本身就是产品语义的选择,所以呈您裁。hotclm 能否用 `visibleWhen` 表达"订单类跳过审查"未在本容器实测。B 不取:靠不完整历史只能猜。C 不取:无 A 之外的拉动,且需契约复审档复核。

**裁后执行:** 选 A ⇒ 席位改派发令(取消"不改代码"停止条件),同一卡线程实施 record-path.tsx + 测试 + changeset,`Clause-②: no`;hotclm 侧声明 `visibleWhen` 由 hotclm 自己跟进。选 C ⇒ 本卡转分诊,按协议新增 p1 走 spec 车道。选 B ⇒ 先另裁"未知"态的呈现。

请回一个字母:A / B / C。

Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #413 · 2026-10-27T12:28Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #413 as item 2 of 3 — the ui seat's question 6441171471 after the card thread's stop (6441110297). Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `fe53769a`):
- Premises hold: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx:443` and `:514` tick every stage with `idx < currentIdx`; the renderer's only record input is the current row. `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` option `visibleWhen`: "option is offered only when TRUE (else omitted)"; `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:188` calls that predicate "the server's enforcement of who may pick an option (ADR-0124 D1)". Triage 6437783999 graded the card p2 `domain:ui` and read a new per-stage key as a protocol addition (p1, spec).
- Half-state: `needs-user-decision` alone (the thread's claim released); the ruling's stroke returns it to `pm:queue`.
- Facets (the seat's block, re-read): ① A reuses a declared, server-enforced contract — an option this record cannot take is not a stage this record walks; C adds a second place to declare the same fact; B makes the renderer depend on incomplete history. ② hotclm ORD contracts today, an auditor reads 「审查中 ✓」 as "legal reviewed this". ③ A is declaration-driven and loud on write; B guesses silently; C drifts between two declarations. ④ A adds no key, read or gate.
- The one product semantic inside A, which is why it is in the box: `visibleWhen` answers "who may pick this value", the path asks "does this record walk this stage"; they coincide for predicates over the record's own columns and diverge for predicates over `current_user`. The seat's guardrail: a predicate that references `current_user` does not hide a stage; a faulting predicate keeps the stage (render side fail-open, ADR-0137 D2/D3). Unmeasured: whether hotclm can express "ORD skips review" as an option `visibleWhen` — the hotclm seat confirms on its own card.
- The seat agrees with **A** with that guardrail. Not B (a new read per record page against the objectui#13010 deferral, and an ambiguous "unknown" state to design) and not C (a protocol key with no pull beyond A). Workload: ui · 1 PR (`record-path.tsx` + tests + changeset) · S; `Clause-②: no`.
Prior rulings read: ADR-0124 D1, ADR-0137 D2/D3, objectui#13010; thread: 6437783999, 6441171471.

Ruling: batch #413 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T13:11Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #413 with 「同意」 — every seat letter. Brief 6441900906; the ui seat's question 6441171471. Letter **A, with the guardrail**: `record:path` omits from both rows any stage whose matching status-field option declares a `visibleWhen` that evaluates FALSE for this record (the option contract of `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, enforced on write by `rule-validator.ts` per ADR-0124 D1); a faulting predicate keeps the stage (render side fail-open, ADR-0137 D2/D3); **a predicate that references `current_user` does not hide a stage** — that predicate answers "who may pick the value", not "does this record walk this stage". Stages are matched to options by value, as `declaredStageKinds` already reads option kind. Not B (a new read per record page against objectui#13010, and an "unknown" state to design) and not C (a protocol key with no pull beyond A).

Workload (card column): ui · 1 PR (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx` + tests + changeset) · S; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. hotclm declares the option `visibleWhen` on its contract-type rule on its own card; whether that rule is expressible as an option predicate is the hotclm seat's reading.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:ui`, p2); the ui seat amends its dispatch order (the "change nothing" stop condition lifts) and the same card thread implements. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.
